meta.title: Home Health Cost Report Benchmarks
meta.description: Aggregate benchmarks (cost per visit by discipline, visit volume, payer mix, operating and Medicare margins) for Medicare-certified home health agencies, built from the CMS data.cms.gov cost report files.

meta.year_definition: CMS's data.cms.gov file year (2020 to 2024). Each yearly file holds cost reports whose periods mostly begin in that calendar year; it is not a uniform fiscal year.
notes: Cost reports are provider-filed and may be unaudited.
The data mixes reports at different CMS statuses (as submitted, settled, reopened) because CMS keeps the highest status per report.
All-payer operating margins include costs that Medicare does not allow.
Partial-year reports (period under 300 or over 430 days) are excluded.
The newest years are incomplete and fill in over time; see counts and latest_complete_year.
Figures are not risk-adjusted or wage-adjusted.
Cells with fewer than 11 agencies are suppressed. No provider-level data is published.
About a third of rows in the CMS files have no financial data (blank Total Cost) and are excluded.
Medicare PPS payments are the four 'Total PPS Payment' episode columns plus the two 'Total PPS Outlier Payment' columns (Wkst D lines 10 to 15; PRM 15-2 section 4715.2).
Share metrics have a pooled value (total numerator over total denominator); per-agency medians can hide small levels of care.
meta.disclaimer: General information from public CMS filings, not an audit, valuation, or advice for any agency.

source_fields: data.cms.gov column 'Skilled Nursing Care-RN, Avg Cost Per Visit' (Wkst C Part I col 4)

metrics.label: Total visits per agency
metrics.definition: Total visits, all disciplines and payers.

metrics.label: Medicare share of visits
metrics.definition: Each agency's Title XVIII (Medicare) visits divided by its total visits. Quartiles and mean are across agencies. The pooled value is total Medicare visits divided by total visits across all agencies in the group.
source_fields: data.cms.gov columns 'Total, Medicare Title XVIII Visits' / 'Total, Total Visits'

metrics.label: All-payer operating margin
metrics.definition: (Net patient revenue minus total operating expenses) divided by net patient revenue. Only where net patient revenue is above zero; margins outside -100% to +100% are excluded as data errors.
source_fields: data.cms.gov columns 'Net Patient Revenues (line 1 minus line 2) Total' (F-1 line 3) and 'Less Total Operating Expenses (sum of lines 4 through 16)' (F-1 line 17)

metrics.label: Cost-based Medicare margin
metrics.definition: (Medicare PPS payments minus total HHA Medicare program cost) divided by Medicare PPS payments. Payments are the sum of the four 'Total PPS Payment' episode columns and the two 'Total PPS Outlier Payment' columns (Wkst D lines 10 to 15), not adjusted for bad debts or sequestration. Margins outside -100% to +100% are excluded as data errors.
source_fields: data.cms.gov columns 'Total PPS Payment - full episodes/periods without outliers'; 'Total PPS Payment - full episodes/periods with outliers'; 'Total PPS Payment - LUPA episodes/periods'; 'Total PPS Payment - PEP episodes/periods'; 'Total PPS Outlier Payment - full episodes/periods with outliers'; 'Total PPS Outlier Payment - PEP episodes/periods'; 'Total HHA Medicare Program Cost'
